ds.skip_tls_hint: For APIs with self-signed certificates. Disables certificate and hostname verification for all requests from this source only. Off by default.
ds.title: Directory synchronization
ds.intro: Import teams, people and on-call schedules from configurable APIs.
ds.name: Name
ds.headers_hint: Stored encrypted and never returned. Leave blank to keep existing headers; {} clears them.
ds.operations_hint: Configure teams, optional team/user, shifts and optional current. Each operation has method, path, params, body, items and pagination.
ds.mapping_hint: Save the connection and inspect response fields first. Use dotted paths or {"value": ...} constants. Match existing teams through team_matches: external ID → local team ID.
ds.enabled_save_first: Save the source, preview the changes and apply the preview before enabling periodic synchronization.
ds.enabled_apply_first: Preview the changes and apply the preview for this configuration before enabling periodic synchronization.
ds.enabled_wait: Wait for the current operation to finish before changing periodic synchronization.
ds.behavior_hint: Local edits to imported fields are replaced by the next sync. Only managed objects are removed, within successfully fetched data. Shared user accounts are retained. Changing configuration requires another preview.
ds.worker_hint: The scheduler worker processes queued runs. Current duty is refreshed separately; expired answers are never used for assignment.
ds.invalid_json: Check JSON syntax in headers, operations and mapping.
ds.saved: Configuration saved. Inspect response fields or preview the import.
ds.local_shift_hint: Times are UTC. Local edits affect assignment and can be overwritten by the next synchronization.
ds.automatic_match: Match automatically or create a team
